bio_model.validity_domain: TECDOC-convention CBE/RBE weights (RBE 3.2 nitrogen capture and hydrogen recoil, CBE_boron 3.8 in the 'tumor' region, 1.0 elsewhere, photon 1.0 by the photon-isoeffective definition) applied to trace-loaded phantom dosimetry as a weighting convention only.

validity_domain: Research demonstration of isoeffective multi-field weight optimization on the layered-head synthetic phantom: meet a tumor EUD floor while bounding brain mean dose and the hottest 1% of the skin+skull shell, under TECDOC-convention photon-isoeffective component weights. Trace boron loading — weights are a convention, not a treatment-representative model.
